// diagnostic

E0318

`` `..=` `` is not a Jet operator — Jet's `..` is already inclusive.

What

`` `..=` `` is not a Jet operator — Jet's `..` is already inclusive.

Why

in Rust, `..` is exclusive and `..=` is inclusive; in Jet, `..` always includes both ends, so there is no `..=`.

Fix

Write `lo..hi` — it already means "lo through hi inclusive."

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0318: tests/ui/range_arm_dot_dot_eq.stderr.

Error [E0318]: `..=` is not a Jet operator — Jet's `..` is already inclusive
  --> tests/ui/range_arm_dot_dot_eq.jet:5:9
    |
  5 |         0..=59 -> { return "fail" }
    |         ^^^^^^
 Why: in Rust, `..` is exclusive and `..=` is inclusive; in Jet, `..` includes both ends
 Fix: write `0..59` — that already includes `59`
